name: Shadowswyft
printedArtCredit: Steve Prescott, A shadowswyft rogue, p. 14.
sourceDistinctions: The race has both darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. Its 40-ft. speed is a base speed.
Light Blindness triggers on abrupt exposure to bright light and causes one round of blindness followed by dazzle while in the affected area.
The examples use the standard Blinded and Dazzled conditions. Neither inherits an additional vulnerability to sunbeam or sunburst.
These encounters take place on the Material Plane, so their type includes the Extraplanar subtype.
portraitForm: Mheer Wink, an original Shadowswyft Rogue
